title: RT Namespace Collision and AER Resolution
purpose: Resolve the RT namespace collision by preserving RT exclusively as Real Truth while introducing AER as the forward canonical abbreviation for ratio-form Affect-Effect relational tension without rewriting historical materials as though the distinction had always been explicit.
summary: RT remains reserved for Real Truth under PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_062. This patch introduces AER (Affect-Effect Ratio) as the forward canonical namespace for reference-relative ratio-form expression of the Affect-Effect relational tension, deprecates RTen, and forbids new canonical material from using RT to abbreviate Relational Tension.

basis.scope: Forward namespace clarification for RT versus Affect-Effect ratio terminology across governed semantic surfaces.

core_rule.statement: RT remains reserved for Real Truth. When new canonical material expresses the relational tension between Affect and Effect in ratio form under a declared reference or projection basis, it must use AER (Affect-Effect Ratio) rather than RT or RTen.

RT.definition: The classification label assigned to an admissibly closed triad, preserved from PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_062.

AER.definition: A reference-relative ratio-form expression of the relational tension between Affect and Effect under a declared projection or observation basis.

relational_tension.definition: The non-collapse Affect-Effect relation. It is not newly abbreviated as RT in canonical materials, and ratio-form renderings must be qualified as AER.

RTen.definition: Deprecated. RTen is not retained as a canonical abbreviation or primitive quantity.

semantic_invariants.rule: RT always expands to Real Truth.
New canonical material must not use RT to abbreviate Relational Tension.
RTen is deprecated and forbidden in new canonical material.
AER is reference-relative and does not silently convert every historical relational-tension phrase into a numeric ratio.
This patch preserves RT_core and does not alter the RT label clarification established by PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_062.

migration_rule.historical_rt_meaning_relational_tension: Reclassify by local context as AER, Affect-Effect relation, relational tension, or legacy project-title residue; do not assume numeric ratio semantics without projection qualification.

preserved: Historical materials that use relational tension in prose without ratio notation
prohibited_readings: RT abbreviates Relational Tension in new canonical material.
RTen remains a valid primitive or quantity.
Every historical relational-tension occurrence automatically denotes a numeric ratio.
Introducing AER modifies RT_core or Real Truth semantics.
forward_review_required: Historical materials that may have overloaded RT by local context.
Future ratio-form Affect-Effect representations that lack declared reference or projection basis.

lexicon_induction.note: The namespace is now governed for canonical usage, but lexicon promotion remains subject to the gap-queue workflow.
